description: Scaffold a custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that integrates with Autodesk Platform Services (APS). Use this skill when the user wants to build, create, generate, or set up an MCP server for APS, Autodesk, Forma, or any Autodesk cloud API. Supports Node.js/TypeScript, .NET/C#, and Python. Handles STDIO (local) and Streamable HTTP (cloud) transport, and various APS auth patterns: 2-legged OAuth, Secure Service Accounts, and 3-legged OAuth.
